<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>set</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable>IO:d2f838578322e250410a73d6feaad3d4</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Total Price calculation</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading){
  if (isLoading) return;

  // Get all rows of the MRVS
  var rows = JSON.parse(g_form.getValue('menu_items'));
  var total = 0;

  // Loop through each row to add up the prices
  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var priceText = rows[i].newValue;
    var price = parseFloat(priceText); // convert text to number
    if (!isNaN(price)) {
      total += price;
    }
  }

  // Set the total into the normal variable
  g_form.setValue('total_price', total.toFixed(2)); // 2 decimal places
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-10 16:31:47</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>3da2d65f83e6e250410a73d6feaad34a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Total Price calculation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Food Delivery System" source="x_946454_food_de_0">d660a9d183ea2a10410a73d6feaad3a7</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Food Delivery System">d660a9d183ea2a10410a73d6feaad3a7</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_3da2d65f83e6e250410a73d6feaad34a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-10 16:43:39</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set display_value="Menu Items">b3ed4a1183ee2a10410a73d6feaad3b1</variable_set><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
